fix(render): today's day sums and the PR stop blocking the first bar (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.2nv) (#610)

* fix(render): today's day sums and the PR stop blocking the first bar; PR lookups are capped and back off (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.2nv)

Totality puts every built-in in every first bar, and both of these are slow
and external. The request's today refresh no longer awaits the directory
scan, the wait set no longer lists today or the PR, and both draw pending and
land through the store they are read from.

The PR source puts every forge lookup through one limiter shared across
repos (the limiter moves out of transcript-fs so both use it), and a key
whose lookups keep failing is retried at a doubling interval up to the ok
period.

The e2e render helper asks again after a bar drawn pending only on these two,
once their refresh is logged.

* fix(git): a PR lookup's logged duration starts at its slot, not at its place in the queue (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.2nv)
